text: After patching ui to healthy (100%) and releasing E, the prompt still shows 'Patching [#########...]' with a partly-filled bar instead of reverting to 'Hold E to patch'. Repro: at v0.3 crosshair on ui, pt hold e 3; pt hold e 1.5; pt shot.

By v0.5 (frame ~?) five modules are rotting at once (search 13%, ui 39%, router 45%, billing 47%, core 64%); health 67%. Patching one takes ~4 s held and needs the module under the crosshair, which on a rolling boulder means rotating it; while pushing nonstop the backlog only grows. Unclear from the screen what happens when one reaches 0%.

v0.6, ~15 m short of 1.0: search hits 0% and shows DOWN in red; HUD line 2 turns red 'OUTAGE: users are leaving' and users drop 400->349. Clear, legible consequence. Weight bar jumped to 8/10 and push feels slower (6 m per 8 s vs 6 m per 5 s at the start).

v0.6 with 12 modules, weight 8/10, one module DOWN: 22 s of holding W moved the boulder only 6 m (20->14 m). The last terrace to 1.0 slows to a crawl (~0.27 m/s vs ~1.2 m/s at 0.0-0.2). Nothing on screen says how weight is computed or that patching/retiring would lighten it.

Q (sit) mid-climb on the last terrace: HUD and help vanish, camera pulls out to show Sisyphus' view up the hill, caption 'The boulder is still. For a moment, so are you.' The boulder holds its place on the slope. Lovely, calm beat.
